questions.explanation: A scientific prediction must risk being wrong.
options: A possible observation could contradict it.
It uses precise technical terminology and equations.

questions.prompt: An ablation study toggles two independent binary changes (each on or off) and runs every combination. How many conditions does this 2×2 design have?
questions.explanation: Each change has 2 settings, and every combination is run: 2 × 2 = 4 conditions (neither, A only, B only, both).

questions.prompt: Two methods are compared on the same 5 random seeds (a paired comparison), and each method is trained once per seed. How many training runs are needed in total?
Three repeated measurements of the same quantity are 2, 4 and 6. The mean is the sum divided by the number of measurements. What is the mean?
A vision model improves after adding augmentation and more data at once. Design an ablation that separates the two effects and state what conclusions remain limited.
rubric: State the model, units, and assumptions.
Show the reasoning and an independently checkable result.
Name a failure case and a verification experiment.
